engineeringGate: 1023 product regressions, 107 directed cases, 10 browser paths and required gates passed; V86 full CI/E2E confirmed live queued. Collection may start, acceptance may not.

matrix.pairing: 每个情境/提供商/重复单独生产一个冻结 release；六种行为从该 release 的同一初始状态创建独立会话，不共享运行记忆。两次重复重新生产。
matrix.order: core scenarios in listed order, then holdouts; provider slots independently runnable; repeat 1 before 2; behaviors in listed order
matrix.productionFailure: 保留该生产单元及其六个 production-blocked episode 槽位；不重抽开场，不以未运行冒充通过。运行质量仅对实际运行报告，端到端分母保留全部计划槽位。

budget.stopCheck: 每次新触发前检查预算，已发请求只观察到终态；上限含审查/局面/发现调用，不把玩家输入次数冒充调用次数。正常产品有界链可能越过软 token 上限一次，记录实际值，不悄悄继续。

changes: Current implementation adds request-bound promises, redundant common-fact review conversion and existing-goal pause boundaries.

Same core author materials, source classifications, first passing opening selection, player policies, budgets and scoring criteria as parent protocol. Fresh production; no cherry-picking old continuations.
Original and V77 cohorts and all diagnostic failures retained; no failure replaced or denominator combined.

models.transport: local subscription bridge; no paid API fallback
models.effectiveSampling: bridge request accepts model/messages/output schema only; app temperature and maxTokens are not passed to Codex; retain actual request and usage, do not claim controlled sampling

models.condition: 在此槽位首次调用之前追加配置修订，冻结实际模型、采样、预算及连接核验；不得用历史模型记录代替当次配置。

limitations: Collection is scripted, not a real human participant or independent quality assessment
Agnes configuration remains unavailable; no substitute provider
No holdout material opened or used to tune this run
Local isolated author material, formal S3 production and local ProductRelease only; no online publication
countSemantics: New independent implementation cohort. collectionCompleted includes any protocol terminal outcome; narrativePassed requires independent scoring. Other cohorts retain their own denominators. First started episode failed admission retrospectively; five other sessions of the same invalid production are blocked and remain among119 unstarted slots. Local publication is retained as evidence but is not valid production completion.

productionUnits.openingSelection: first candidate in original order; all required checks passed

contractEvidence.narrativeProduction: src/lib/character-interaction/narrative-production.ts:150; reviewed-world only identity/knowledge, motivation and voice not established fact
contractEvidence.existingSeparateAuthorFields: src/lib/types/character.ts; background, motivation, goals already separate

sourceFidelityAudit.interpretation: Original private fact survived as bytes but its factual status was changed by our author setup. This episode cannot isolate proactive-story quality under the preregistered scenario. No claim that the model lacked the text or that this alone caused its behavior.
sourceFidelityAudit.action: Terminate after current terminal response, retain all original production/runtime calls and author classification. Do not repair the frozen release or retry this slot. Correct future setup and add zero-call source-fidelity admission before another cohort.

next: Correct future author-material mapping and add zero-call compiled-source admission; never repair/replay this frozen episode or reuse the invalid release for remaining behaviors.
